hook: New Zealand still doesn't know who won
reel_hook: One country still doesn't know who won

slides.title: NZ vote: too close to call
slides.image_prompt: A sealed ballot box on a wooden table beside a brass scale with two perfectly equal weights, New Zealand flag folded nearby, soft morning light
slides.label: POLITICS
points: WHAT HAPPENED
New Zealand's 7 November election is still too close to call.
WHY IT MATTERS
Now everyone waits for the special votes to be counted.
FOR YOU
Treat any early winner claims with caution until special votes are counted.

slides.title: Ukraine talks set for Abu Dhabi
slides.image_prompt: Three empty chairs around a round negotiating table with glasses of water, Abu Dhabi skyline at dusk through a large window
slides.label: WORLD
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Ukraine, Russia and US talk in Abu Dhabi, 10–11 November.
WHY IT MATTERS
First direct three-way talks since February, on ending the war.
FOR YOU
On 10–11 November, ending the war, Europe's security and rebuilding top the agenda.

slides.title: Democrats take both chambers
slides.image_prompt: The US Capitol dome at sunset with a wooden gavel resting on an empty desk in the foreground
slides.label: POLITICS
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Democrats won the House and Senate in the 3 November midterms.
WHY IT MATTERS
It means a Democratic Congress facing a Republican president.
FOR YOU
Once seated, Democratic majorities will shape which bills reach the president's desk.
slides.body: Democrats won the House and Senate in the 3 November midterms. It means a Democratic Congress facing a Republican president. Once seated, Democratic majorities will shape which bills reach the president's desk.

slides.title: NZ's big two may need help
slides.image_prompt: Two large chess kings on a board surrounded by several small pawns, one pawn stepping forward, dramatic side light
slides.label: POLITICS
points: WHAT HAPPENED
National and Labour may struggle to govern without smaller parties.
WHY IT MATTERS
Coalition talks could decide who governs, not just the count.
FOR YOU
In 2023 National won 48 seats with 38.06%; expect coalition deals again.
slides.body: National and Labour may struggle to govern without smaller parties. Coalition talks could decide who governs, not just the count. In 2023 National won 48 seats with 38.06%; expect coalition deals again.

slides.title: A parliament that can grow
slides.image_prompt: Rows of green parliament benches in an empty chamber with a few extra chairs added at the edges, warm light
slides.label: CURIOSITY
points: WHAT HAPPENED
NZ's parliament has 120 seats, plus extra 'overhang' seats.
WHY IT MATTERS
So the majority line can shift with each election.
FOR YOU
When NZ seat totals are announced, check the overhang: it moves the majority line.
slides.body: NZ's parliament has 120 seats, plus extra 'overhang' seats. So the majority line can shift with each election. When NZ seat totals are announced, check the overhang: it moves the majority line.
